name: R7
summary: R7 is a small-molecule flavonoid and orally active, potent, and selective agonist of the tropomyosin receptor kinase B (TrkB) – the main signaling receptor for the neurotrophin brain-derived neurotrophic factor (BDNF) – which is under development for the treatment of Alzheimer's disease.

pharmacology.text: R7 is a small-molecule flavonoid and orally active, potent, and selective agonist of the tropomyosin receptor kinase B (TrkB) – the main signaling receptor for the neurotrophin brain-derived neurotrophic factor (BDNF) – which is under development for the treatment of Alzheimer's disease.

fact.en: R7 is a flavonoid, the family of plant pigments that includes the colours of berries and tea. It was found to switch on the TrkB receptor, which normally responds to the growth factor BDNF.
fact.zh: R7 是類黃酮，這一類植物色素包含了莓果和茶的顏色成分。研究發現它能啟動 TrkB 受體，而這個受體平常是由生長因子 BDNF 來活化的。
